title: Magazine p. 46: Photo of Agena-12 from Gemini-12 (NASA S-66-63101)
description: Photocopied magazine page with a photograph (numbered 13) showing a diagonal line of bright objects and a structure against a dark background, captioned "Photo of Agena-12 from Gemini-12. This is part of a sequence of photos which takes the Agena from light into dark. After dark, only the running lights are visible." The caption notes one researcher published the latter photograph as a "UFO" and cites NASA photo S 66-63101. Article text discusses "cosmonaut UFOs," the Soyuz-11 "transcript," and the author's work with NASA photo interpreter Richard Underwood.
